fields.label: Appearance Note
fields.options: 🎨 Appearance  Configure the portal's visual identity — branding, typography, theme colours, status indicators, and grade colour bands. Changes apply globally to all faculty portal pages.

Layout Note
fields.options: 🗍️ Layout & Navigation  Control the portal's structural layout — sidebar position and width, navbar height, corner style, density, and attendance colour thresholds. Changes take effect on the next page load for all faculty users.

fields.description: Controls which colour band is displayed for each student's attendance percentage across all faculty views
fields.label: Attendance Thresholds

fields.description: Attendance at or above this percentage is shown in Success (green) color
fields.label: Good Attendance Threshold (%)

fields.description: Attendance at or above this (but below Good threshold) is shown in Warning (amber) color. Below this is Danger (red).
fields.label: Warning Attendance Threshold (%)

fields.description: Label shown when attendance is at or above the Good threshold
fields.label: Good Attendance Label

fields.description: Label shown when attendance is between Warning and Good thresholds
fields.label: Warning Attendance Label

fields.description: Label shown when attendance is below the Warning threshold
fields.label: Danger Attendance Label

fields.description: Position of the sidebar navigation panel
fields.label: Sidebar Position

fields.description: Width: Narrow = 200px, Normal = 240px, Wide = 280px
fields.label: Sidebar Width

fields.description: Height of the top navigation bar: Compact = 50px, Normal = 60px, Tall = 72px
fields.label: Navbar Height

fields.description: Card corner style: Sharp = 6px, Normal = 14px, Pill = 20px
fields.label: Corner Style

fields.description: Compact reduces card/nav padding for a denser information display
fields.label: Layout Density

fields.description: Show the faculty employee ID below the name in the sidebar profile card
fields.label: Show Faculty ID in Sidebar

fields.description: Show the faculty's department name below the employee ID in the sidebar profile card
fields.label: Show Department in Sidebar
Features Note
fields.options: 📋 Dashboard Features  Toggle individual panels on or off for all faculty users. Disabled panels are completely hidden from the portal dashboard. Faculty may further personalise visible panels if self-service customisation is enabled.

fields.description: Toggle individual dashboard panels on or off for all faculty users
fields.label: Dashboard Panels

fields.description: Show the scrolling announcement ticker below the navbar
fields.label: Announcements Ticker

fields.description: Show today's teaching schedule panel on the dashboard
fields.label: Today's Schedule Panel

fields.description: Show a count and list of pending evaluations (unmarked assignments, pending marks entry)
fields.label: Pending Evaluations Panel

fields.description: Show class attendance and grade distribution statistics on the dashboard
fields.label: Class Statistics Panel

fields.description: Show the Quick Actions shortcuts bar on the dashboard
fields.label: Quick Actions Panel

fields.description: Show a workload summary showing credit hours and session count for the current semester
fields.label: Workload Summary Panel

fields.description: Show the faculty's leave balance and recent leave request status
fields.label: Leave Status Panel

fields.description: Show a compact overview of student performance (pass/fail ratio, top/bottom performers) for the faculty's courses
fields.label: Student Performance Overview

fields.description: Show upcoming exam/assessment dates relevant to the faculty's courses
fields.label: Upcoming Exams Panel
Modules Note
fields.options: ⚙️ Modules  Enable or disable individual faculty modules — Attendance, Marks & Grading, Assignments, Student Interaction, and Leave & Workload. Disabling a module hides it entirely from the portal navigation. Module-specific restrictions (edit windows, booking limits) are also configured here.

fields.description: Configure attendance marking behaviour and restrictions for faculty
fields.label: Attendance Module

fields.description: Enable the attendance marking module. Disable to completely hide it from the faculty portal.
fields.label: Enable Attendance Marking

fields.description: Allow faculty to upload or mark attendance in bulk (entire class at once)
fields.label: Enable Bulk Attendance

fields.description: Show student passport-size photographs in the attendance marking UI to reduce proxy attendance
fields.label: Show Student Photos in Attendance

fields.description: Automatically close an open attendance session after this many minutes. Set to 0 to disable auto-close.
fields.label: Auto-Close Session After (minutes)

fields.description: Alert the faculty when the system detects a potential proxy attendance pattern for a student
fields.label: Enable Proxy Attendance Alert

fields.description: Number of days after a session date within which faculty can still edit marked attendance. Set to 0 for no restriction.
fields.label: Attendance Edit Window (days)

fields.description: Configure marks and grading features available to faculty
fields.label: Marks & Grading

fields.description: Enable the marks entry module. Disable to completely hide it from the faculty portal.
fields.label: Enable Marks Entry

fields.description: Allow faculty to enter separate internal / continuous assessment marks alongside final exam marks
fields.label: Enable Internal Marks

fields.description: Show grade distribution charts and class performance statistics after marks are published
fields.label: Show Class Grade Statistics

fields.description: Allow faculty to edit marks after they have been submitted. Enabling this may require HOD approval (see below).
fields.label: Allow Marks Edit After Submission

fields.description: Require HOD / Exam Controller approval before edited marks are saved. Applicable only when marks edit is enabled.
fields.label: Marks Edit Requires Approval

fields.description: Allow faculty to add textual remarks against each student's grade entry
fields.label: Enable Grade Remarks

fields.description: Configure the assignment and submission features available to faculty
fields.label: Assignments & Submissions

fields.description: Enable the assignments module. Disable to completely hide it from the faculty portal.
fields.label: Enable Assignment Module

fields.description: Allow faculty to accept and mark late submissions even after the due date has passed
fields.label: Allow Late Submission Marking

fields.description: Send an email notification to the faculty when a student submits an assignment
fields.label: Assignment Submission Email Notification

fields.description: Show a plagiarism similarity indicator badge on each submission (requires plagiarism detection integration)
fields.label: Show Plagiarism Similarity Indicator

fields.description: Configure how faculty interact with students through the portal
fields.label: Student Interaction

fields.description: Enable the office hours booking system so students can schedule time with the faculty
fields.label: Enable Office Hours Booking

fields.description: Show student email and contact number to faculty on the student profile and attendance pages
fields.label: Show Student Contact Info

fields.description: Enable the student query / Q&A system through which students can post questions to the faculty
fields.label: Enable Student Query System

fields.description: How many days in advance a student can book an office hours slot. Applies globally to all faculty.
fields.label: Office Hours Advance Booking (days)

fields.description: Maximum number of simultaneous active bookings a faculty member can have at any given time
fields.label: Max Concurrent Bookings per Faculty

fields.description: Configure leave request and workload indicator features for faculty
fields.label: Leave & Workload

fields.description: Enable the leave request module so faculty can submit and track leave applications from the portal
fields.label: Enable Leave Request

fields.description: Show a workload indicator bar in the sidebar and dashboard showing current vs. maximum teaching hours
fields.label: Show Workload Indicator

fields.description: Method used to calculate and display teaching workload on the dashboard
fields.label: Workload Calculation Method

fields.description: Maximum weekly teaching hours used as the 100% reference point for the workload indicator bar
fields.label: Max Weekly Teaching Hours
Permissions Note
fields.options: 🔒 Self-Service Permissions  Control which portal settings each faculty member can personalise independently. Enabled permissions are surfaced in the Faculty Portal User Preferences page. Restrict these to maintain a consistent institutional look and feel.

fields.description: Control which portal settings each faculty member can personalise without administrator intervention. Enabled permissions are surfaced in the Faculty Portal User Preferences page.
fields.label: Faculty Self-Service Permissions

fields.description: Let faculty choose their own portal theme colour scheme. They can pick from presets or set a custom primary colour.
fields.label: Allow Theme Override

fields.description: Let faculty switch between Compact and Normal layout density from their own preferences page
fields.label: Allow Layout Density Override

fields.description: Let faculty manage their own email notification preferences (which events trigger emails and how frequently)
fields.label: Allow Notification Preferences

fields.description: Let faculty show or hide individual dashboard panels from their own preferences page
fields.label: Allow Dashboard Customization

fields.description: Let faculty adjust the portal base font size (Small / Normal / Large) for readability
fields.label: Allow Font Size Override

fields.description: Let faculty set their preferred portal interface language (requires i18n translations to be installed)
fields.label: Allow Language Preference
Advanced Note
fields.options: ⚠️ Advanced — Custom CSS  Inject raw CSS that is appended after all portal stylesheets. Use CSS variables like --fp-primary and --fp-secondary for theme-consistent overrides. Incorrect CSS here can break the portal layout — test changes carefully before saving.

fields.description: Controls the "Sign in with NLS Google account" option on the faculty login page
fields.label: Login & Security

fields.description: Show a "Sign in with NLS Google account" button on the faculty login page. Requires a Social Login Key for Google to be configured and enabled.
fields.label: Enable Google Login for Faculty

fields.description: Only Google accounts on this domain may log in as faculty (e.g. nls.ac.in). Leave blank to allow any domain (not recommended for production).
fields.label: Allowed Google Account Domain

fields.description: Inject raw CSS appended after all portal styles. Use CSS variables like --fp-primary for colour consistency.
fields.label: Advanced — Custom CSS

fields.description: Raw CSS injected at the end of every faculty portal page. Use CSS variables like --fp-primary, --fp-secondary for theme colour consistency.
fields.label: Custom CSS
